name: Pearl S. Buck
viewpoint: Sun Wukong is 'a free spirit, a rebel who fights against fate'
contribution: Introduced the spirit of Journey to the West to the Western world

name: Jorge Luis Borges
work: A commentary on Journey to the West
viewpoint: The charm of this novel lies in 'the infinity of the fantastical' — each ordeal is like opening another door, and this structure itself contains a profound metaphor for life's journey
contribution: Reads the book from a structuralist perspective

name: Kenzaburō Ōe
viewpoint: The influence of Journey to the West on the minds of East Asian youth — 'it is like the starry sky of our childhood, illuminating the future'
contribution: Affirms the book as shared East Asian cultural memory
